n62aa9df463.summary: The Casablanca Stock Exchange started trading on a positive note with its main Masi index gaining 0.30 percent to 13,117.66 points.

n17ff84d74f.headline: Sensex hits new milestone, breaches 60,000-mark for first time as markets defy weak European cues; watch video
n17ff84d74f.summary: India's benchmark Sensex index hit a new milestone, crossing the 60,000 level for the first time, defying weak market signals from Europe.
n17ff84d74f.why: The Sensex is a key indicator of India's stock market health and investor sentiment, reflecting economic growth and corporate performance in one of the world's largest emerging markets.

impacts.name: Sensex
impacts.why: The Sensex crossing 60,000 signals strong investor confidence and market momentum in India.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n17ff84d74f.why_moved: The milestone reflects strong domestic investor demand and resilience despite weak European market cues, indicating positive economic outlook in India.

nc7ec85c1ef.headline: Over One Hundred Employers Offer Jobs at the Unemployment Insurance Virtual Job Fair
nc7ec85c1ef.summary: More than 100 employers are offering jobs at Estonia's unemployment insurance virtual job fair, with high participation from job seekers and companies.
nc7ec85c1ef.why: Virtual job fairs support labor market matching and employment recovery amid economic challenges.
